name: Blast Away Pressure Washing Services LLC
address: 726 Mc Dermott Ave, Melbourne, FL 32935, United States
website_check: Google Maps listing shows 'Add website' (no website button). WebSearch for "Blast Away Pressure Washing" Melbourne FL found no owned domain, no Instagram, no Facebook; the only loose match ("Brush & Blast, LLC") is a different, unconfirmed business and was not treated as this one.
hours: Open 7 days a week, 8 AM to 7 PM

source_of_data.discovery: CHROME_PATH=/usr/bin/google-chrome python3 scripts/maps_discover.py --niche "pressure washing" --location "Melbourne, FL" --limit 8 --min-rating 4.5 --min-reviews 10 -> candidate (Blast Away Pressure Washing Services LLC, 4.8, 22 reviews, no website)
source_of_data.detail: node scripts/gmaps_detail.js <mapsUrl> -> rating 4.8, reviews 22, address, phone, hours 8AM-7PM all 7 days, website null, owner bio mentions a 'back on Google' relaunch note
source_of_data.reviews: node scripts/gmaps_reviews.js <mapsUrl> 10 -> 4 unique verbatim 5-star reviews after de-dup (Greg Heyman, Mike Vicente, Carol Shear, Leonard Conte), all English, naming the technician Jerry/Jeremiah
source_of_data.photos: node scripts/gmaps_photocycle.js <mapsUrl> 30 -> 11 unique Google Maps photos after de-dup (1 exact duplicate removed), visually curated one by one with Read tool; 7 kept as real before/after and crew photos, 4 excluded (a sinkhole/broken-concrete photo unrelated to pressure washing shown twice, plus a scenic gazebo shot with no visible wash result)

reviews_verbatim.author: Greg Heyman
reviews_verbatim.text: They did an excellent job pressure cleaning my house, driveway and pool area. Very prompt response and was able to do the job the next day. I had some hard rust stains and they went out of their way to clean it up. Jerry went back to his …

reviews_verbatim.author: Mike Vicente
reviews_verbatim.text: Jeremiah is amazing! He was on time, Very knowledgeable and did an amazing job on the driveway at my workplace! 10/5

reviews_verbatim.author: Carol Shear
reviews_verbatim.text: Jerry did a fantastic job on my pool cage, patio and front porch. He was on time, polite, and considerate of my property. He was thorough and professional. He takes pride in his work. He did a few extra things within the original estimate. I am very pleased and will call him again in the future.

reviews_verbatim.author: Leonard Conte
reviews_verbatim.text: Absolutely great experience, Jerry was on site within 1 hour. Results were fantastic, and very reasonably priced. Clearly has a great depth of knowledge. Thanks!!!
